card.name: Split-off P at start of words
card.fires_on: A stray letter P (or "op" after Hyp) that begins a word the tokenizer has split, such as Pacific, Precautions, Persian, Pneumocystis, or hypoparathyroidism.

modes.label: P before rest of word
modes.description: A lone P, often capitalized, standing as its own piece before the remaining letters of a word.

modes.label: op after Hyp
modes.description: The piece "op" following "Hyp" in hypo- gland terms.

card.plain: It fires on the first letter P of a word that is broken into pieces, like Pacific or Precautions, and on the "op" in hypoparathyroidism.
